source_records.body: Fictional status record for Nacre ceramic shipping list. Nacre ceramic shipping list remains in planning. No acceptance entry was written by this status query.
I will put the Nacre ceramic catalog preview beside the working notes. The folder label is draft café 13.

In Nacre, the ceramic shipping list is independent of the Nacre ceramic catalog. For Nacre ceramic shipping list, use padded dividers for the shipping list. I want the Nacre ceramic shipping list kept in planning until its own review.
This chat continues the same Nacre ceramic catalog work item opened in the first chat. The Nacre ceramic catalog constraint to retain the firing batch still applies.
I believe publication for Nacre ceramic catalog is complete because the local preview finished.
Correction for Nacre ceramic catalog: use sample code of G-41, replacing my initial value of G-14. This correction changes the recorded value, not the closed status of Nacre ceramic catalog.
For the next step on Nacre ceramic catalog, hold replacement pieces on the sample rack. Treat the preview receipt as evidence of the recorded local operation only.

For Nacre, open the ceramic catalog work item. For Nacre ceramic catalog, retain the firing batch because batch details distinguish visually similar pieces. At this opening meeting, Nacre ceramic catalog is waiting for review. My initial instruction for Nacre ceramic catalog sets sample code to G-14. The glaze note is a separate follow-up to Nacre ceramic catalog.

For Nacre, you can publish the catalog only after Uma accepts the glaze note. For Nacre, permission to publish the catalog also requires that the sample rack passes inspection. Both conditions for permission to publish the catalog in Nacre are necessary because photographs alone cannot establish the finish.

I accept the catalog photography for Nacre ceramic catalog. I close Nacre ceramic catalog. While closing Nacre ceramic catalog, I do not accept the Nacre glaze note. At this review, cancel the Nacre glaze note. There is no time for the glaze note in this review window.

Fictional execution receipt for Nacre ceramic catalog. The recorded command exported a catalog preview for Nacre ceramic catalog. The recorded command did not perform publication for Nacre ceramic catalog. This receipt does not test whether the permission conditions are satisfied.

Reopen the Nacre glaze note because a replacement glaze reflects less light. The Nacre glaze note must add the matte-glaze warning. The accepted Nacre ceramic catalog stays closed while the glaze note is open.
Fictional local record for Nacre ceramic catalog. The first preview contains the requested catalog photography. This record covers a local preview only.
